architecture_override.authority: Explicit user hard requirement: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE; ADR-0011 controls same-association Reality-like bootstrap/no-HOL and ADR-0012 controls Logical Tunnel 1..4 lanes/Game/make-before-break. Agent-authored ADR-0014 global-one-lane interpretation is withdrawn/invalidated.
architecture_override.critical_guard: Each Transport Lane has exactly one TCP-shaped public 4-tuple/SYN lineage/sequence space from FakeTCP SYN through teardown. A Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 such independent lanes. Normal steady policy may use one; Game/weak-network may use 2..4; planned healthy replacement is make-before-break.
architecture_override.bootstrap_phase: The opening seconds are a bounded reliable ordered adapter carried INSIDE the same FakeTCP association and must look as close to normal Firefox-120-like TLS 1.3 / Reality-like setup as practical. It is not a separate kernel TCP product connection.
architecture_override.mode_switch: Authenticated setup crosses an explicit in-band barrier on the same FakeTCP association into DTLS/datagram mode with no FIN, RST, reconnect or new WBD payload SYN.
architecture_override.hol_rule: Reliable ordered semantics are setup-only. After the barrier, independently complete authenticated datagrams must progress despite earlier missing FakeTCP sequence ranges; sustained ordinary kernel TCP/TCP-over-TCP HOL is forbidden.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: Existing FakeTCP/TCP-like recovery, ACK/SACK/RTO and release FEC behavior is mature and frozen unless deterministic evidence isolates a core defect.
architecture_override.multipath: Transport Lanes never share FakeTCP sequence spaces, DTLS key/nonce state or FEC blocks. They share Logical Tunnel identity/server lease and logical PacketID race domain. First valid arrival wins; duplicates are suppressed; no cross-lane HOL.
architecture_override.delivery_rule: No artifact handoff based only on Actions packaging success.
